_about: Closed-heart fragment (List 30 #287) — the corruption state as a STORED record on #80's family, with the stored-not-derived argument carried in _why_stored. Absent heart field = open heart (#96 absent = default). Zero closures instanced; gauge bands and cause contents are data/canon slots.

freeze_rules.care: #28 loop and #132 services work normally — care never requires an open heart
freeze_rules.evolution: no #199 edge fires while closed; re-tested after opening on then-facts, never queued
freeze_rules.experience: #177 gain banked, levels held (#178 derivation reads applied gain only)
freeze_rules.growth_presentation: #243 life-stage read holds at its closing-moment shape
freeze_rules.obedience: broken, not inverted — refusal/idle/#289 frenzy on #273 machinery; bond to the holder does not accrue while closed (#180 declaration law)

never: a benefit state — nothing on the far side of a closed heart is worth having (#290 shadow moves leave at opening)
a player upgrade path against their own kept Mochi
a write to personality_seed (#80), temperament (#108), or mood (#202)

read.device_function: aura read on the #81 device / #149 show-device grammar
read.precision: gauge BAND shown, never a fake-precise number
screen_classes: identify (entry assembles with the closure shown as a dark band)

heart.bankedGain: #177 gain events held in reserve while closed — paid out whole at opening (#288); never applied, never lost
heart.gauge: int — current closure remaining; 0 = ready to open (#288)
heart.gaugeMax: int — set at closing from the individual's facts + cause class; deeper process, larger gauge

record.placement: a field on #80's individual record family, beside personality_seed — the seed is NEVER written by this system

why_stored: gauge is changed by events in order-dependent ways — not computable from other facts
the gauge is evidence: it must survive #168/#268 transfers byte-intact, never recomputed
#288 opening is a threshold crossing of this exact stored value
